senses.gloss:
m. (-णः)
INDRA'S elephant.
E.
इरावत् the ocean, अण affix of descent; ocean-born: न is changed irregularly to ण.

m. (-तः)
1 INDRA'S elephant.
2 The same, considered as the elephant of the north quarter.
3 An orange.
4 A fruit, (Artocarpus lacucha.)
5 A serpent, one of the chiefs of the Nāga or serpent race, inhabiting the infernal regions.
f. (-ती)
1 Lightning.
2 A particular kind of it.
3 The female of INDRA'S elephant.
4 The Rāvī river in the Pañjāb.
n. (-त)
INDRA'S bow unbent, the rainbow.
E.
इरावत् water-having; that is, the ocean, a cloud, &c. अण् affix implying origin or descent; born from the ocean, (the elephant,) proceeding from watery clouds, (lightning, &c.)
